_comment: GENERATED by `npm run flag:hash` from challenges.meta.json + .flags.env. No plaintext flags. Hashes depend on FLAG_PEPPER; re-generate if it changes.

challenges.title: The Snack Cabinet
challenges.description: A developer with a sweet tooth left something behind on this website. It looks like a cookie, but the recipe seems to be scrambled. Can you figure it out?

challenges.title: Restricted Area
challenges.description: This website has a set of instructions meant for search engine bots. Sometimes, instructions meant to hide things from bots only make them more obvious to a clever human.

challenges.title: The Messenger
challenges.description: We captured a conversation between two computers on our network. It seems they were using an old, insecure protocol. The password might have been sent in plain sight.

challenges.title: The VIP Lounge
challenges.description: Only authorized personnel are allowed in the VIP lounge. The bouncer is tough, but we suspect the database that checks the guest list can be easily confused.

challenges.title: Whispers in the Wire
challenges.description: Two operatives were exchanging secrets, but they were clever. They broke their message up into tiny pieces and sent it over the wire. Can you reassemble their conversation?

challenges.title: Local Traffic Only
challenges.description: This server is configured to only show its secrets to visitors from the inside. Is there a way to make it think your request is coming from a trusted local source?

challenges.title: The Golden Ticket
challenges.description: Upon visiting this site, you are handed a digital pass, a "token," that identifies you as a guest. What if you could upgrade your own pass to that of an administrator?

challenges.title: Forgotten Files
challenges.description: A lazy developer was working on a new script for this site. We think they might have saved a backup copy of their work somewhere on the server with a common backup extension.

challenges.title: The Reading Room
challenges.description: This internal company portal lets employees view different pages by changing the URL. Perhaps it can be convinced to show a file it isn't supposed to, like a sensitive configuration backup?

challenges.title: The Ping Test
challenges.description: To help with network diagnostics, this page offers a simple tool to check if a machine is online. What else could you make this tool do if it handles your input carelessly?

challenges.title: OTP Bypass
challenges.description: This brand-new registration portal sends an OTP to your phone for security. But is it really secure? Maybe the developers overlooked something simple in the verification step.

challenges.title: IDOR Profile Viewer
challenges.description: Welcome to our social platform! You can view your own profile, but what about others? Some user profiles might be more interesting than the rest. Look for the VIP!

challenges.title: Cookie Stealer
challenges.description: We value your input! Leave feedback for our admin team. They read every single message. Every. Single. One. They also have very valuable session cookies.

challenges.title: Leaky Downloads
challenges.description: This system allows you to download your personal documents. It's supposed to be secure, but a misconfiguration might let you peek at files that aren't yours.

challenges.title: Reflected XSS
challenges.description: Use our new search engine! It's fast, powerful, and reflects your queries perfectly. Maybe a little *too* perfectly.
